newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ South Island wool sale postponed to March 6.
newsitem.headline: NZ South Island wool sale postponed to March 6.

text.p: Next week's South Island wool sale has been deferred a week, the New Zealand Woolbrokers' Association said on Wednesday.
The association said wet weather, particularly in Southland, had prevented farmers from shearing.
The Timaru and Invercargill wools which would have been offered at the sale on February 27 will now be sold with wools from Christchurch and Dunedin on March 6. The total offering is 19,000 bales.
On the same day, 17,000 bales of North Island wools will be sold at Napier. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
